entities.name: Jean Thierry du Mont, comte de Gages
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean Bonaventure Thierry du Mont, 1st Count of Gages, Viceroy of Navarre, 1746–1753, a Knight of the Order of the Golden Fleece in 1745, was a Walloon born Spanish General who was awarded by King Philip V of Spain in 1745 the title of "Conde", "Count", of Gages, a village near Brugelette in Hainaut.
